text: きみを　みくびって　いた　ようだ　ぼくに　かった　あかしに　ポケモン　リーグ　こうにん　グレー　バッジを　さずけよう！

structure.jp: きみを　みくびって　いた　ようだ
structure.en: it seems I was underestimating you

structure.jp: ぼくに　かった　あかしに
structure.en: as proof that you beat me

structure.jp: ポケモン　リーグ　こうにん　グレー　バッジを
structure.en: the official Pokémon League Gray Badge

patterns.name: 〜ようだ
patterns.span: みくびって　いた　ようだ
patterns.explanation: ようだ after a verb says 'it seems that', judging from what you have seen. みくびって　いた　ようだ = 'it seems I was underestimating you'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ぼくに　かった　あかし
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase put right before a thing describes that thing. The に after it then means 'as'. ぼくに　かった　あかし = 'proof that you beat me'.

patterns.name: 〜よう (I will)
patterns.explanation: The よう ending on a verb says 'I will' or 'let me' when the speaker decides to do something. さずけよう = 'I shall give it to you'.
